scope: Read-only native provenance audit; only this audit JSON is written. Does not change references, old SHA values or external character files.
selectionMode: union of available per-group selection files; pending selections excluded
limitations: Current external SHA is audit-time content, not generation-time evidence. Frozen request SHA is reported only if a matching references entry actually exists.
Missing references SHA in a readable request is not a contradictory SHA; it is absent evidence.
